status_events.counterevidence_considered: Artificial Analysis's points use current list prices, not launch prices, and its GPQA harness differs from Epoch's; both push the reading towards slower, so the true pace may still sit inside the fast band.
status_events.reason: Epoch stopped updating its price chart in February 2025, so the series now continues on Artificial Analysis: each later model that clears GPT-4's own GPQA Diamond score there and undercuts every model before it. On nine points from 2023 to April 2026 the lowest price halves every 114 days (CI 74-243), just outside the fast band (110 days or less) and well inside the gap before normal (230 days or more), so the status stays emerging. The Epoch-only fit read 68 days; the stitched points carry today's price at their release dates, which reads slower than the launch-price history would.

status_events.reason: Epoch's price-trend series for the GPQA Diamond threshold set by GPT-4-0314: the lowest price per million tokens halves every 68 days (CI 38-317) on six points from 2023 to December 2024, inside the fast band (110 days or less, about 40x a year). Single tier-6 source with six points caps the status at emerging; the series ends in December 2024 and is refreshed when Epoch republishes it. Initial seed.

timing_rationale: Coincident: prices fall the day a cheaper model matches the benchmark, when buyers can switch.
tracker_interpretation: Few points, and the cheapest model at a fixed threshold is rarely the frontier; the METR-hour price series on OpenRouter is the companion reading.
why_it_matters: Price per unit of capability on a benchmark axis, the lab layer's capture proxy; the brief cites about 40x a year at this threshold.
